name: Encore

tierList.prydwen: T2 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes (playable as Hypercarry or Dual-DPS)

kit.intro: 5-star Fusion Rectifier DPS, very flexible field time (Hypercarry or Quickswap Dual-DPS). Ultimate transforms her into melee-focused 'Cosmos Rampage' state with its own Basic/Heavy/Skill kit. Forte 'Dissonance' (max 100) unlocks an enhanced Heavy Attack (70% DMG reduction while channeling, then a big Liberation-type nuke) usable during Ultimate for maximum effect.

skills.resonanceSkill: Flaming Woolies - fireball barrage (2-part: Flaming Woolies -> Energetic Welcome, second part rarely used in practice).
skills.forte: Black & White Woolies - Dissonance gauge; enhanced Heavy Attack (Cloudy Frenzy / Cosmos Rupture in Ultimate) grants 70% DMG reduction while channeling.
skills.liberation: Cosmos Rave - transforms Encore into melee Cosmos Rampage form with its own enhanced Basic/Heavy/Skill/Dodge Counter kit for the duration.
skills.intro: Woolies Can Help! - Fusion DMG pounce.
skills.outro: Thermal Field - AoE burn zone, ~177% ATK Fusion DMG every 1.5s for 6s.

echoSet: Flaming Clawprint (alt, for Dual-DPS teams with Changli/Brant)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Lupa now edges out Sanhua as best partner thanks to higher Fusion buffs; Sanhua remains a strong, very F2P-friendly alternative.

teams.name: Best Team (Dual DPS)
teams.notes: Brant's Skill+Fusion DMG Amplify Outro slightly edges out Changli's Liberation Amplify for Encore.

rotation: Echo -> Intro -> Ultimate (Cosmos Rampage) -> Skill (Cosmos: Rampage) -> Basic Cosmos: Frolicking P1-P4 (repeat with dash/skill cancels) -> Forte Heavy (Cosmos Rupture, swap-cancel) -> Outro. Advanced play trades the Forte Heavy for a third Skill cast + extra basics for higher damage.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the most flexible and beginner-friendly 5-star DPS - works as Hypercarry or Dual-DPS, forgiving rotation with built-in gap closers, easy to pick up. Main technical hurdle is timing the Forte-enhanced Heavy Attack's small swap-cancel window.
